notes:
Alternate lines.

- Every game on the Odds screen has an Alternate lines button: a ladder of that game's other spreads and totals, every book's price, a fair price for each line, and the best price you can bet marked.
- One game at a time, the cost shown before you press (up to 4 credits for both ladders in two regions), and kept on this Mac so it reopens for free.
